mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the previous quarter's growth rate signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerated consumption growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market overheating, which raises wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of unemployment below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below the previous quarter's level signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of industrial production contraction (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of elevated federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below the previous quarter's growth rate signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of decelerating consumption growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market slack, which reduces wage pressures and inflation expectations, lowering discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of elevated unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO) above the previous quarter's growth rate signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of accelerating industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).
